newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian tyre-maker Sava to be listed in autumn.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian tyre-maker Sava to be listed in autumn.

text.p: Slovenian tyre producer Sava said on Friday it hopes to launch its shares on the Ljubljana bourse in autumn.

"Our wish is to be listed as soon as possible and if everything goes well, I hope we will appear on the market then (in autumn), but it's not all down to us," Miroslav Matijasevic, deputy finacial manager of Sava, told Reuters.
Sava decided on Thursday to form two joint ventures with the Goodyear Tire & Rubber Co. Sava's shares are currently traded on the grey market at 6,000 tolars ($31-$37).
The company said it would pay its first ever dividend of 100 tolars per share by the beginning of next month.

Sava's 1996 net profit jumped to 247 million tolars from 7.9 million in 1995. The company said profit surged as a consequence of various rationalisation moves in its production process and a cut in costs.
Turnover in 1996 increased to 33.5 billion tolars from 30.8 billion a year ago. -- Novica Mihajlovic, Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439 ($ = 160.8 Slovenian Tolars)
